verdict.rationale: Paddle.js lets developers add checkout directly to their app or website. Inline checkout embeds the checkout in the merchant's own interface and shows items and totals in their own UI, and overlay checkout is an on-page option instead of a redirect. The Next.js starter kit also ships an integrated checkout. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of how far the components can be customized (styling, theming, field control), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the embedded experience.
